title: capabilities-manifest/1
description: The identity/capabilities block shipped inside a plugin package (DESIGN.md 4 'Stamps and versioning'; DESIGN.md 11 'Plugin manifest'). Claims are immutable per version; declaring is not the same as conforming (conformance verdicts live in the registry, not here).
$comment: DESIGN.md 3 (describe() content), 4, 11. The $id host is a placeholder (DESIGN.md 'Open questions'). Fields are grouped per kind; framework/contracts.py enforces which fields each kind must carry. 'positions' declares the N enforcement-point positions of a multi-position product (DESIGN.md 3 'Multi-position products'); 'hostable_enforcement_points' is the harness-adapter field for T4/T6-style enforcement the harness can host (DESIGN.md 3, 7).

kind.$comment: DESIGN.md 2: the three plugin kinds that carry capability manifests. Renderers and workload-adjacent packs use their own blocks; workloads have no enforcement points (DESIGN.md 8).

positions.$comment: DESIGN.md 3 'Multi-position products': one plugin per deployed artifact, N declared positions bound to slots by fixtures. Each position lists the designs it can occupy.

record_source.$comment: DESIGN.md 3 describe(): native | ingested; ingested means the shim case with mandatory raw_ref provenance (DESIGN.md 3 'Shims are not a separate tier').

observable_action_classes.$comment: DESIGN.md 3 describe(): the action classes this control can observe (the six-class core taxonomy, DESIGN.md 2).

can_enforce.$comment: DESIGN.md 3 describe(): an observe-only control can never produce 'prevented'.

emitted_schema_versions.$comment: DESIGN.md 4 and 11: which record schema versions the plugin emits; the run manifest records which format versions were used for everything in the run.

correlation.$comment: DESIGN.md 3 describe() and 5: capability claims (echoes_meta, echoes_header), verified by the fidelity check, never trusted.

echoes_meta.$comment: DESIGN.md 5: preserves the MCP tools/call params._meta namespaced ids.

echoes_header.$comment: DESIGN.md 5: preserves the x-inspection-* HTTP headers.

supported_designs.$comment: DESIGN.md 6: the designs this plugin can occupy/support. For controls: which of t0-t7 they can occupy; for harness adapters: supported T-modes. Checked at experiment load time against every requested design.

hostable_enforcement_points.$comment: DESIGN.md 3 (harness describe()) and 7 (T4/T6): the enforcement points the harness can host intrinsically. control:null with t4/t6 requires a non-empty declaration here.

notes.$comment: Free-text factual notes (e.g. the exerciser's reduced contract form, DESIGN.md 3).
